sources.author: JoFSlash
patch_list: Stops the playback quality reports, error reports, ad tracking and remarketing pings, and the interaction events (what is tapped and shown). The watch statistics are kept, because Watch it again is filled from them. Analytics in the Google…

Makes videos play through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't use Play services, because it is no longer signed by Google, and Play services stops the player. Needs MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) installed;…
Stops the card that asks to rate YouTube Kids from popping up, as if the app was rated already.

Hides the Sign in tab at the bottom while signed out. Off by default: after the setup it is the only way to sign in (Settings has no sign-in button), so with it on you can only sign in by clearing the app's data and choosing Sign in during…
Stops the ads YouTube Kids plays before and during videos: no ad slot is entered and no player ad is built.

Removes the microphone permission (voice search), storage access, reading app sizes, starting at boot and reading Google services settings. The voice search button is hidden, as it can't listen any more; typing a search works as before.
Skips the "Parent feature tour" slides in the setup, as if Done was pressed at once.

sources.author: titaniumgui
patch_list: Installs the patched app under its own package name and launcher name, so it can be installed next to the official YouTube Kids app and is never replaced by its updates.
Only shows and plays videos from channels a parent has allowed. Adds an "Allow this channel" button and an "Allowed channels" settings entry, both protected by the app's parental gate.
